sub.title: I`m Luffy! The Man Who`s Gonna Be King of the Pirates!
sub.titleJapanese: 俺はルフィ! 海賊王になる男だ!

sub.description: Alvida pirates plunder a ship only to find a barrel containing a strange boy names Luffy who is on a quest to find the legendary One Piece and become the King of Pirates.

sub.title: Enter the Great Swordsman! Pirate Hunter Roronoa Zoro!
sub.titleJapanese: 大剣豪現る! 海賊狩りロロノア・ゾロ
sub.titleRomanji: Daikengou Arawaru! Kaizokugari Roronoa Zoro
sub.description: Luffy and his new companion Coby set sail in search of the infamous pirate hunter Zoro, rumored to be held captive at the Marine Base.

sub.title: Morgan vs. Luffy! Who`s the Mysterious Pretty Girl?
sub.titleJapanese: モーガンVSルフィ! 謎の美少女は誰?
sub.titleRomanji: Morgan VS Luffy! Nazo no Bishoujo wa Dare?
sub.description: Luffy is in the line of fire after saving Zoro, and now tyrannical Captain Morgan is out for their heads! Zoro must decide if he will join forces with Luffy or die in captivity.

sub.title: Luffy`s Past! Enter Red-Haired Shanks!
sub.titleJapanese: ルフィの過去! 赤髪のシャンクス登場
sub.titleRomanji: Luffy no Kako! Akagami no Shanks Toujou
sub.description: Luffy recalls a time when Captain Red-Haired Shanks taught him a valuable lesson in friendship and set him on his quest to be King of the Pirates.

sub.title: A Terrifying Mysterious Power! Captain Buggy, the Clown Pirate!
sub.titleJapanese: 恐怖 謎の力! 海賊道化バギー船長!
sub.titleRomanji: Kyoufu Nazo no Chikara! Kaizoku Douke Buggy-Senchou!
sub.description: Luffy crosses paths with the clever thief Nami. A navigator on a quest to collect one hundred million berries, she’s perfect for Luffy’s new crew – except for the fact that Nami hates pirates.

sub.title: Desperate Situation! Beast Tamer Mohji vs. Luffy!
sub.titleJapanese: 絶体絶命! 猛獣使いモージ VS ルフィ!
sub.titleRomanji: Zettai Zetsumei! Moujuu Tsukai Mohji VS Luffy!
sub.description: Having delivered a deadly blow to Captain Buggy’s pirates, Luffy and his companions need a place to recuperate. But the three are not in hiding very long before the Beast Tamer Mohji seeks them out.

sub.title: Epic Showdown! Swordsman Zoro vs. Acrobat Cabaji!
sub.titleJapanese: 壮絶決闘! 剣豪ゾロ VS 曲芸のカバジ!
sub.titleRomanji: Souzetsu Kettou! Kengou Zoro VS Kyokugei no Cabaji!
sub.description: In the ongoing fight with Captain Buggy's pirates, Zoro must face off with the Acrobat Cabaji while Luffy continues to do battle with the Pirate Clown himself.

sub.title: Who Is the Victor? Devil Fruit Power Showdown!
sub.titleJapanese: 勝者はどっち? 悪魔の実の能力対決!
sub.titleRomanji: Shousha wa Docchi! Akuma no Mi no Nouryoku Taiketsu!
sub.description: Luffy and the gang are on the run after the battle with Captain Buggy! With no place to go and nothing else to do, Nami finally agrees to join Luffy on his quest.

sub.title: The Honorable Liar? Captain Usopp!
sub.titleJapanese: 正義のうそつき? キャプテンウソップ
sub.titleRomanji: Seigi no Usotsuki? Captain Usopp
sub.description: Kaya rewards the Straw Hat Pirates' efforts to save her with a ship to call their own - the Going Merry!

sub.titleJapanese: 史上最強の変な奴! 催眠術師ジャンゴ

sub.description: On the legendary Treasure Island, Luffy and crew encounter strange animals and an even stranger man named Gaimon.

sub.description: In the past, young Zoro sparred constantly with a girl named Kuina, but he could never claim victory. They vowed that one of them would someday be the world's greatest swordsman - but tragedy intervened.

sub.title: Clash with the Black Cat Pirates! The Great Battle on the Slope!
sub.titleJapanese: 激突! クロネコ海賊団坂道の大攻防!

sub.title: Luffy Back in Action! Miss Kaya`s Desperate Resistance!
sub.titleJapanese: ルフィ復活! カヤお嬢様の決死の抵抗

sub.titleJapanese: 怒り爆発! クロVSルフィ決着の行方!

sub.titleJapanese: 三刀流の過去! ゾロとくいなの誓い!

sub.description:
Barely surviving in a barrel after passing through a terrible whirlpool at sea, carefree Monkey D. Luffy ends up aboard a ship under attack by fearsome pirates. Despite being a naive-looking teenager, he is not to be underestimated. Unmatched in battle, Luffy is a pirate himself who resolutely pursues the coveted One Piece treasure and the King of the Pirates title that comes with it.

The late King of the Pirates, Gol D. Roger, stirred up the world before his death by disclosing the whereabouts of his hoard of riches and daring everyone to obtain it. Ever since then, countless powerful pirates have sailed dangerous seas for the prized One Piece only to never return. Although Luffy lacks a crew and a proper ship, he is endowed with a superhuman ability and an unbreakable spirit that make him not only a formidable adversary but also an inspiration to many.

As he faces numerous challenges with a big smile on his face, Luffy gathers one-of-a-kind companions to join him in his ambitious endeavor, together embracing perils and wonders on their once-in-a-lifetime adventure.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
